fields.title: 📖 The Messenger ﷺ brings to light what was hidden of the Book
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“The Messenger ﷺ came to bring to light much of what had been hidden of the Book, and Allah sent down light and a clear Book.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The case of Rajm fits precisely this principle: revelation is concealed, and the Messenger ﷺ makes the Ḥukm of Allah visible again.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Māʾidah 5:15.
